thread:
nate_marketing: Preflight for tomorrow's announcement (09:00 PT send). Need: final headline (one line), short changelog blurb for the email, canonical docs URL, single benchmark stat for hero, rollout window, and sales tag verification. @kevin_eng @sophie_docs @alan_prod @irene_salesops :mag:

kevin_eng: Rollout plan: start 08:00 PT with a 3% canary for 12m, then 20% for 18m, 100% by 09:00 PT if healthy. Watch error rate >0.4% or p95 increase >22% -> pause and investigate. No infra blockers.

alan_prod: Bench highlight from our e2e trace: cost per token down 27% vs v2.3; p95 latency improved 14% on chat traces. Recommend marketing copy: "reduces token cost by up to 30% on common chat workloads" (rounded).

sophie_docs: Docs are published at https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/v2-5 and changelog at /v2-5/changelog. I added an "opt-in" migration snippet and a short note about compatibility flags. Migration snippet (copyable):
```json
{"serving": {"quantization": "enabled", "kernel_preference": ["int8_fast", "int8_compat"]}}
```

irene_salesops: Sales routing ready. Web leads will get auto-tag "launch_v2_5" and route to queue "launch-inbound". I'll run a quick smoke test after send.

nate_marketing: Headline drafts (pick one):
- "v2.5: smarter batching and quantized kernels for faster, cheaper inference"
- "Cut token costs up to 30% with v2.5"
Which should we use? Need hero PNG and alt text too.

alan_prod: Prefer the first for technical readers, second for headline on homepage. Perf PNG uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/v2-5-hero.png Alt: "p95 latency and cost comparison, v2.4 -> v2.5". CSV attached.

kevin_eng: Minor note: dynamic kernel swapping may require clients to opt into the new runtime for now; I've added a short line in docs. No roll blocking issues.

release-bot: Release pipeline scheduled by kevin_eng at 1912345740. CI: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/55421 :gear:

nate_marketing: Plan: send at 09:00 PT with the technical headline on the engineering blog and the short consumer headline for the mailing list. Include docs + migration snippet, hero image, bench stat, and webinar CTA (Thu 11am PT). Salesops will verify tagging. Any last flags?

kevin_eng: Monitoring dashboards up. We'll post live status.

release-bot: Canary deployed at 1912345760. 3% canary running. Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/55421/console

kevin_eng: Canary stable at 08:12 PT. Moving to 20%. No spike in errors.

release-bot: Full rollout completed at 1912345798. Status: success.

nate_marketing: LIVE  announcement sent at 09:00 PT. Irene, confirm tag smoke test when you can. Thanks all :tada:
